evidence.quote: Courses are held entirely in English.
You can then use these details to apply via uni-assist.

notes: Tuition: the quote 'None' for tuition fees per semester on the DAAD page is a programme-specific statement that there are no tuition fees; the HSRW living costs page confirms no tuition fees at this state university. The application deadline 15 July is stated for the winter semester on the DAAD page; it is included with year 2027 as the next winter semester, but the year 2027 is not explicitly quoted, only day and month. Application channel: DAAD page and HSRW page both state international applicants apply via uni-assist, not uni-assist VPD. Documents: no page provided a list of documents international applicants must submit, so the documents fact is omitted.

note.fr: Un stage préparatoire de 8 semaines est requis ; il n'est pas nécessaire à l'admission initiale mais doit être fait avant le 4e semestre.
note.en: An eight-week preparatory internship is required; not needed for initial admission but must be completed by the fourth semester.

evidence.quote: Completion of an eight-week preparatory internship. This is not required for initial admission, but it must be met by the fourth semester re-enrolment deadline at the latest.
